levels.OBSERVED: Directly present in committed bytes, exports, source, or a read-only body/assembly observation.
levels.SUPPORTED: Two or more independent static sources agree, but no positive original runtime trace exists.
levels.INFERRED: A bounded interpretation from topology, naming, partial decompilation, or adjacent contracts.
levels.UNKNOWN: Evidence does not establish the type, meaning, ABI, or behavior.

evidence_policy.name_rule: SDK and imported symbol names are hypotheses unless corroborated by fields, vtables, decompilation, or consumers. Scanner labels and FUN_ names never become semantic identities by themselves.
evidence_policy.offset_rule: SDK/export offsets are observations of the imported layout. Decompiler field names and apparent argument roles remain bounded where warnings or containing-function repairs exist.
evidence_policy.runtime_rule: No editor/UI claim is runtime verified. Positive original editor/UI traces are absent.
evidence_policy.xref_rule: Caller/consumer statements use committed canonical xrefs or explicitly named live-only observations; indirect dispatch is not promoted to a direct call.
evidence_policy.replaceability_rule: Replaceable means a clean-room boundary may be substituted, not that behavior or binary ABI compatibility has been recovered.

major_claims.claim: The editor is an IGameMode plus ILayer, IHintConditioner, INameableEntity, IMessageListener, and DefaultRefCounted multiple-inheritance object, not a single-interface widget.
major_claims.provenance: cEditor has six adjacent vptr fields at offsets 0x00 through 0x14 and refcount at 0x18; the constructor writes six vtable-related addresses; the 0x013f57f8 candidate matches the first 16 IGameMode slots and then continues into additional virtuals.

major_claims.claim: UTFWin is the replaceable UI infrastructure boundary: window tree, message routing, layout loading, drawable painting, and widget adapters are separable from editor policy.
major_claims.provenance: 1093 UTFWin functions, 247/306 vtable associations, 71-slot IWindow, 7-slot IWinProc, layout/drawable interfaces, and many cross-cluster consumers support a framework boundary rather than isolated widgets.

major_claims.claim: The central input boundary is cGameInputManager plus GameInput state; editor/cell/camera consumers are downstream mode callbacks.
major_claims.provenance: cGameInputManager has 27 slots with explicit key/mouse callbacks and mode IDs; the accessor has 614 total and 80 gameplay callers; cEditor and cell mode implement IGameMode input slots.

major_claims.claim: The pdtk text-widget command channel is observable but not SDK-defined and is not a portable ABI.
major_claims.provenance: The dossier records pdtk_text_new, select, focus, and icursor command construction and five local callers; committed SDK exports contain no pdtk type.

major_claims.claim: A distinct menu type is not established; main-menu behavior must be treated as data/layout/button/message composition.
major_claims.provenance: No SDK Menu symbol or structure exists in committed exports, while GUI-boundary evidence identifies a rendered main menu and editor input/message roots.

major_claims.claim: Editor model persistence exists at the SDK method boundary, but the exact on-disk format and containing-function ABI are not recovered.
major_claims.provenance: EditorModel::Load/Save and cCreatureDataResource::Read/Write are contained SDK labels; Editor_Save reaches the containing save path, but no exact standalone decompilation or format contract exists.

major_claims.claim: The current tree has useful clean-room cell input/mode/HUD/renderer seams but no original editor, UTFWin, message-manager, pdtk, layered renderer, or animation/UI-object implementation.
major_claims.provenance: Current source defines reduced InputEvent, CellInput, CellUI, GameModeManager, CellGfx, and flat/textured IRenderer contracts; interactive input bypasses IGameMode callbacks.

major_claims.claim: The current IGameMode slot comments disagree with the committed SDK interface layout.
major_claims.provenance: SDK IGameMode places Initialize at slot 4, Dispose at 5, OnEnter at 6, OnExit at 7, key/mouse callbacks at 9 through 14, and Update at 15; src/apps/IGameMode.hpp labels Initialize as slot 6 and later slots shifted by two.

current_src_comparison.provenance: Current clean-room source compared against recovered original contracts.

components.finding: Current InputEvent has virtualKey, modifiers, x, and y but lacks mouse button, wheel delta, held/released state, and mouse-state fields. Current slot comments are shifted relative to the SDK 16-slot interface.
CellInput has a table-driven held-key state and frame/camera projections, but interactive SDL input bypasses IGameMode callbacks and does not route through a mode/input-region manager.
Current manager stores non-owning mode pointers and drives OnExit/OnEnter; it does not reproduce the original manager registry, allocation, input regions, or full mode set.
No original-equivalent window tree, layout resource loader, message union, priority proc list, button/text editor, or pdtk grammar exists.
No listener/handler priority registry, send/post queue semantics, standard-message payload, or lock/dispose contract exists.
No editor root, model/rigblock document, edit history, play-mode modules, animation bridge, or editor UI controller exists.
Current CellUI models GlobalUICell-3 constants and a rollover vector but not the full 2372-byte state, object pool, layout, progress bar, or original rendering path.

Current IRenderer supports one mesh/texture path and one active frame; it lacks the original 36-slot layer registry, render jobs, viewer, multiple displays, UI painter, and model-world/effect/shadow contracts.

replaceability_assessment.provenance: Boundary classification combines static dependency structure, current reusable components, and unresolved behavioral contracts.

infrastructure.why: The original centralizes input in cGameInputManager/GameInput and dispatches IGameMode callbacks; a clean-room router can replace it once event ordering, regions, and mode transitions are characterized.
Its interfaces are broad and replaceable by a modern retained/immediate UI toolkit, but layout, message order, focus, input routing, and painter behavior must be specified first.
Observed commands can be replaced by direct text-widget APIs; exact grammar is unnecessary for a clean-room visual replacement but remains necessary for fidelity tracing.
No distinct menu ABI is established; composition can be rebuilt from window/layout/button/message contracts after the transition path is observed.
The original resource/property compatibility surface is unresolved, so replacement could break existing creature/editor assets.
Input-to-tool-to-model-to-animation contracts are dependency-first and have no positive runtime oracle.
Current Vulkan/IRenderer covers static textured cell presentation but not original layer/world/effect/shadow/UI painter behavior.
A new event bus can replace it, but editor/message IDs, payload unions, priority, reentrancy, and listener lifetime must first be captured.

replaceability_assessment.verdict: The infrastructure seams are replaceable as clean-room boundaries, not as ABI-compatible copies. Editor document/asset semantics and runtime-verified tool/message behavior are the non-replaceable gaps at present.

contradictions_and_boundaries.resolution: Keep base-interface associations as SUPPORTED and concrete dynamic-subtype identities as hypotheses.

contradictions_and_boundaries.issue: cEditor candidate has 29 slots while App::IGameMode has 16
contradictions_and_boundaries.provenance: The first 16 candidate slots align with IGameMode; the remaining slots are additional virtuals/adjacent continuations.
contradictions_and_boundaries.resolution: Do not label all 29 slots as IGameMode.

contradictions_and_boundaries.issue: Current IGameMode slot comments disagree with SDK layout
